; GENERATED FILE — do not edit. Regenerate after changing
; send-to-notion.qmd:
;
;     python3 app/qmd/scripts/make-debug.py
;
; rm-notion — Send to Notion (QMLDiff / .qmd for qt-resource-rebuilder)
;
; Requires xovi with qt-resource-rebuilder and qt-command-executor
; (import net.asivery.CommandExecutor). The notion-bridge daemon must be
; running (installed as a systemd service by the package).
;
; ANCHORS: the AFFECT blocks at the bottom target reMarkable OS 3.27.x
; (resolved against a real device hashtab). For other OS versions,
; re-anchor per packaging/vellum/README.md — the SLOT blocks are
; firmware-independent.

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The full-screen overlay: pairing (QR + poll), target picker with search,
; PDF/SVG toggle, page range, send progress.
; All plain QtQuick primitives, e-ink friendly, no QtQuick.Controls.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SLOT rmNotionOverlay
    INSERT {
        Rectangle {
            id: rmNotionOverlay

            property string rmnDocUuid: ""
            property string rmnDocName: ""
            property string rmnMode: "checking"
            property string rmnErrorText: ""
            property string rmnDeviceCode: ""
            property string rmnQrPath: ""
            property string rmnSendFormat: "pdf"
            // "embed" renders the file on the Notion page (a pdf or image
            // block); "file" adds it as a download row.
            property string rmnAttachAs: "embed"
            property string rmnBlockUrl: ""
            // One entry per connected Notion account, as returned by
            // targets.list: {account_id, workspace, pages, error}.
            property var rmnAccounts: []
            // Connected accounts as reported by status: {id, workspace}.
            property var rmnAccountList: []
            property var rmnSelectedTarget: null
            property string rmnPendingAction: ""

            // Inserted as a child of DocumentView's full-screen root, so
            // filling the default parent already covers the screen. Do not
            // reparent via Window.window (unavailable in this QML scope).
            anchors.fill: parent
            color: "white"
            visible: false
            z: 1000

            CommandExecutor {
                id: rmnExec
            }

            // Synchronous call into the daemon's CLI client mode. Returns
            // {result} or {error}.
            function rmnCall(method, params) {
                var raw = rmnExec.executeCommand(
                    "/home/root/.vellum/bin/notion-bridge",
                    ["-call", method, "-params", JSON.stringify(params || {})])
                // CommandExecutor.executeCommand returns a JSON envelope
                // string: {"stdout": "...", "stderr": "..."}. Unwrap it, then
                // parse the daemon's own JSON out of stdout. Tolerate an
                // already-unwrapped map in case the extension changes shape.
                var env = raw
                if (typeof env === "string") {
                    var trimmed = env.trim()
                    if (!trimmed)
                        return {error: "no response from notion-bridge — is the daemon running?"}
                    try {
                        env = JSON.parse(trimmed)
                    } catch (e) {
                        return {error: "bad response: " + trimmed}
                    }
                }
                if (!env)
                    return {error: "no response from notion-bridge — is the daemon running?"}
                var out = ("" + (env.stdout || "")).trim()
                console.warn("[rmn] call " + method + " out=<" + out + "> err=<" + env.stderr + ">");
                if (!out) {
                    var err = ("" + (env.stderr || "")).trim()
                    return {error: err || "no response from notion-bridge — is the daemon running?"}
                }
                try {
                    return JSON.parse(out)
                } catch (e) {
                    return {error: "bad response: " + out}
                }
            }

            function rmnOpen(uuid, name, range) {
                rmnDocUuid = uuid
                rmnDocName = name || "Notebook"
                rmnErrorText = ""
                rmnBlockUrl = ""
                rmnSelectedTarget = null
                rmnPageRange.text = range || ""
                console.warn("[rmn] overlay.rmnOpen uuid=" + uuid + " parent=" + parent
                             + " w=" + width + " h=" + height);
                rmnSearch.text = ""
                visible = true
                console.warn("[rmn] overlay visible=" + visible + " z=" + z);
                // Defer the first bridge call one frame so the overlay
                // paints before any synchronous work runs.
                rmnDefer("refresh")
            }

            function rmnDismiss() {
                rmnPollTimer.running = false
                visible = false
            }

            function rmnDefer(action) {
                rmnPendingAction = action
                rmnDeferTimer.restart()
            }

            function rmnFail(message) {
                rmnErrorText = "" + message
                rmnMode = "error"
            }

            function rmnRefreshStatus() {
                rmnMode = "checking"
                var r = rmnCall("status", {})
                if (r.error) { rmnFail(r.error); return }
                rmnAccountList = r.result.accounts || []
                if (r.result.authed) {
                    rmnMode = "pick"
                    rmnLoadTargets("", false)
                } else {
                    rmnStartPairing()
                }
            }

            // Pairing adds an account; it never replaces the connected
            // ones, so this is also how "Add account" works.
            function rmnStartPairing() {
                rmnMode = "pair"
                rmnDeviceCode = ""
                rmnQrPath = ""
                var r = rmnCall("pair.start", {})
                if (r.error) { rmnFail(r.error); return }
                rmnDeviceCode = r.result.device_code
                rmnQrPath = r.result.qr_png_path
                rmnPollTimer.running = true
            }

            function rmnPollPairing() {
                var r = rmnCall("pair.poll", {device_code: rmnDeviceCode})
                if (r.error) { rmnPollTimer.running = false; rmnFail(r.error); return }
                if (r.result.state === "ok") {
                    rmnPollTimer.running = false
                    rmnMode = "pick"
                    rmnLoadTargets("", false)
                } else if (r.result.state === "expired") {
                    rmnPollTimer.running = false
                    rmnFail("Pairing code expired — try again.")
                }
            }

            // Pull fresh pages. rmnResync also re-reads each workspace name
            // from Notion first, for when one was renamed since pairing.
            function rmnResync() {
                rmnMode = "checking"
                rmnDefer("resync")
            }

            function rmnLoadTargets(query, refresh) {
                var r = rmnCall(refresh ? "targets.refresh" : "targets.list",
                                {query: query})
                if (r.error) { rmnFail(r.error); return }
                rmnAccounts = r.result.accounts || []
                console.warn("[rmn] targets accounts=" + rmnAccounts.length
                             + " listCount=" + rmnList.count
                             + " listH=" + rmnList.height);
                rmnMode = "pick"
            }

            function rmnDoSend() {
                var r = rmnCall("send", {
                    doc_uuid: rmnDocUuid,
                    page_range: rmnPageRange.text,
                    format: rmnSendFormat,
                    target_page_id: rmnSelectedTarget.id,
                    account_id: rmnSelectedTarget.accountId || "",
                    attach_as: rmnAttachAs
                })
                if (r.error) { rmnFail(r.error); return }
                rmnBlockUrl = r.result.block_url || ""
                rmnMode = "done"
            }

            // Drop one connection. Removing the last one falls back to the
            // pairing screen via rmnRefreshStatus.
            function rmnRemoveAccount(accountId) {
                rmnCall("logout", {account_id: accountId})
                rmnSelectedTarget = null
                rmnRefreshStatus()
            }

            function rmnShowAccounts() {
                var r = rmnCall("status", {})
                if (!r.error)
                    rmnAccountList = r.result.accounts || []
                rmnMode = "accounts"
            }

            // One-frame deferral so state changes paint before sync work.
            Timer {
                id: rmnDeferTimer
                interval: 60
                repeat: false
                onTriggered: {
                    var a = rmNotionOverlay.rmnPendingAction
                    rmNotionOverlay.rmnPendingAction = ""
                    if (a === "refresh") rmNotionOverlay.rmnRefreshStatus()
                    else if (a === "send") rmNotionOverlay.rmnDoSend()
                    else if (a === "search") rmNotionOverlay.rmnLoadTargets(rmnSearch.text, false)
                    else if (a === "resync") rmNotionOverlay.rmnLoadTargets(rmnSearch.text, true)
                }
            }

            Timer {
                id: rmnPollTimer
                interval: 3000
                repeat: true
                running: false
                onTriggered: rmNotionOverlay.rmnPollPairing()
            }

            Rectangle {
                id: rmnHeader
                width: parent.width
                height: 96
                color: "white"
                border.color: "black"
                border.width: 2

                Text {
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    x: 32
                    // No workspace here: the picker groups pages under a
                    // section header per account, which is where the
                    // workspace belongs once more than one is connected.
                    text: "Send to Notion"
                    font.pixelSize: 34
                    font.bold: true
                }
                Text {
                    id: rmnResyncLink
                    visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "pick"
                    anchors.right: rmnAccountsLink.left
                    anchors.rightMargin: 40
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    text: "Refresh"
                    font.pixelSize: 24
                    font.underline: true
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            rmnSearch.focus = false
                            rmNotionOverlay.rmnResync()
                        }
                    }
                }
                Text {
                    id: rmnAccountsLink
                    visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "pick"
                             || rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "accounts"
                    anchors.right: rmnClose.left
                    anchors.rightMargin: 40
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    text: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "accounts" ? "Done" : "Accounts"
                    font.pixelSize: 24
                    font.underline: true
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            if (rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "accounts")
                                rmNotionOverlay.rmnDefer("refresh")
                            else
                                rmNotionOverlay.rmnShowAccounts()
                        }
                    }
                }
                Rectangle {
                    id: rmnClose
                    width: 96; height: 64
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.rightMargin: 24
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "X"; font.pixelSize: 30 }
                    MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: rmNotionOverlay.rmnDismiss() }
                }
            }

            Text {
                visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "checking"
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                text: "Checking connection..."
                font.pixelSize: 30
            }

            Column {
                visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "pair"
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                spacing: 28
                width: 640

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                    text: "Scan with your phone to connect a Notion workspace"
                    font.pixelSize: 30
                }
                Image {
                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                    width: 512; height: 512
                    cache: false
                    source: rmNotionOverlay.rmnQrPath ? "file://" + rmNotionOverlay.rmnQrPath : ""
                }
                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                    text: rmNotionOverlay.rmnDeviceCode ? "Waiting for approval..." : "Requesting code..."
                    font.pixelSize: 24
                    color: "#444444"
                }
            }

            Item {
                visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "accounts"
                anchors.top: rmnHeader.bottom
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                width: parent.width

                Column {
                    x: 32
                    y: 24
                    width: parent.width - 64
                    spacing: 0

                    Repeater {
                        model: rmNotionOverlay.rmnAccountList

                        delegate: Rectangle {
                            width: parent.width
                            height: 88
                            color: "white"

                            Text {
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                x: 12
                                width: parent.width - 220
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                text: modelData.workspace || "Notion"
                                font.pixelSize: 28
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 160; height: 60
                                anchors.right: parent.right
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                                    text: "Remove"
                                    font.pixelSize: 24
                                }
                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    onClicked: rmNotionOverlay.rmnRemoveAccount(modelData.id)
                                }
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: parent.width; height: 1
                                color: "#cccccc"
                                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Item { width: 1; height: 32 }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: 320; height: 72
                        color: "black"
                        Text {
                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                            text: "Add account"
                            font.pixelSize: 28
                            color: "white"
                        }
                        MouseArea {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            onClicked: rmNotionOverlay.rmnStartPairing()
                        }
                    }

                    Text {
                        width: parent.width
                        wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                        text: "Adding an account pairs another Notion workspace — "
                              + "a personal one alongside work, say. Pages appear "
                              + "grouped by workspace in the picker."
                        font.pixelSize: 22
                        color: "#777777"
                        topPadding: 24
                    }
                }
            }

            Item {
                visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "pick"
                anchors.top: rmnHeader.bottom
                anchors.bottom: rmnFooter.top
                width: parent.width

                // Tapping empty space drops focus so the on-screen keyboard
                // goes away; sits below the search box and list, so taps on
                // those still reach them.
                MouseArea {
                    anchors.fill: parent
                    z: -1
                    onClicked: rmnSearch.focus = false
                }

                Rectangle {
                    id: rmnSearchBox
                    x: 32; y: 24
                    width: parent.width - 64
                    height: 72
                    border.color: "black"; border.width: 2

                    TextInput {
                        id: rmnSearch
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: 18
                        font.pixelSize: 28
                        clip: true
                        onAccepted: {
                            focus = false
                            rmNotionOverlay.rmnDefer("search")
                        }
                    }
                    Text {
                        anchors.fill: rmnSearch
                        text: "Search pages..."
                        font.pixelSize: 28
                        color: "#999999"
                        visible: rmnSearch.text === "" && !rmnSearch.activeFocus
                    }
                }

                ListView {
                    id: rmnList
                    anchors.top: rmnSearchBox.bottom
                    anchors.topMargin: 16
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                    x: 32
                    width: parent.width - 64
                    clip: true

                    model: {
                        // A flat row list with section headers, so pages sit
                        // under the workspace they belong to.
                        var rows = []
                        var accounts = rmNotionOverlay.rmnAccounts
                        for (var a = 0; a < accounts.length; a++) {
                            var acc = accounts[a]
                            rows.push({kind: "header",
                                       label: acc.workspace || "Notion"})
                            if (acc.error) {
                                rows.push({kind: "note", label: acc.error})
                                continue
                            }
                            var pages = acc.pages || []
                            if (pages.length === 0) {
                                // Notion has no "whole workspace" grant: a
                                // connection only sees pages the user picked,
                                // so say how to widen it.
                                rows.push({kind: "note", label: "No pages shared yet — re-add this account and pick a top-level page to include everything under it"})
                                continue
                            }
                            for (var j = 0; j < pages.length; j++) {
                                var pg = pages[j]
                                rows.push({kind: "page", id: pg.id, title: pg.title,
                                           icon: pg.icon, accountId: acc.account_id,
                                           depth: pg.depth || 0, note: ""})
                            }
                        }
                        return rows
                    }

                    delegate: Item {
                        width: rmnList.width
                        height: modelData.kind === "page" ? 76
                                : modelData.kind === "header" ? 64 : 60

                        property bool rmnIsSelected:
                            modelData.kind === "page"
                            && rmNotionOverlay.rmnSelectedTarget
                            && rmNotionOverlay.rmnSelectedTarget.id === modelData.id
                            && rmNotionOverlay.rmnSelectedTarget.accountId === modelData.accountId

                        // Workspace section header.
                        Rectangle {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            visible: modelData.kind === "header"
                            color: "#eeeeee"
                            Text {
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                x: 12
                                width: parent.width - 24
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                text: modelData.label
                                font.pixelSize: 24
                                font.bold: true
                                color: "#333333"
                            }
                        }

                        // "no pages" / per-account error line.
                        Text {
                            visible: modelData.kind === "note"
                            anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                            x: 24
                            width: parent.width - 48
                            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                            text: modelData.label
                            font.pixelSize: 22
                            color: "#777777"
                        }

                        // Selectable page row.
                        Rectangle {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            visible: modelData.kind === "page"
                            color: parent.rmnIsSelected ? "black" : "white"

                            // Sub-pages are indented under their parent, the
                            // way they nest in Notion.
                            Rectangle {
                                visible: modelData.depth > 0
                                x: 12 + (modelData.depth - 1) * 36 + 10
                                width: 2
                                height: parent.height - 24
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                color: parent.parent.rmnIsSelected ? "#888888" : "#cccccc"
                            }
                            Text {
                                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                x: 12 + modelData.depth * 36
                                width: parent.width - 24 - modelData.depth * 36
                                elide: Text.ElideRight
                                text: (modelData.icon ? modelData.icon + "  " : "")
                                      + modelData.title
                                      + (modelData.note ? "   -  " + modelData.note : "")
                                font.pixelSize: 28
                                color: parent.parent.rmnIsSelected ? "white" : "black"
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: parent.width; height: 1
                                color: "#cccccc"
                                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                            }
                            MouseArea {
                                anchors.fill: parent
                                onClicked: {
                                    rmnSearch.focus = false
                                    rmNotionOverlay.rmnSelectedTarget = {
                                        id: modelData.id,
                                        title: modelData.title,
                                        icon: modelData.icon,
                                        accountId: modelData.accountId
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Rectangle {
                id: rmnFooter
                visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "pick"
                width: parent.width
                height: 196
                anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                color: "white"
                border.color: "black"; border.width: 2

                Column {
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    x: 32
                    spacing: 16

                    Row {
                        spacing: 24

                        // Render format.
                        Row {
                            spacing: 0
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 110; height: 64
                                color: rmNotionOverlay.rmnSendFormat === "pdf" ? "black" : "white"
                                border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                                    text: "PDF"
                                    font.pixelSize: 26
                                    color: rmNotionOverlay.rmnSendFormat === "pdf" ? "white" : "black"
                                }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: rmNotionOverlay.rmnSendFormat = "pdf" }
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 110; height: 64
                                color: rmNotionOverlay.rmnSendFormat === "svg" ? "black" : "white"
                                border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                                    text: "SVG"
                                    font.pixelSize: 26
                                    color: rmNotionOverlay.rmnSendFormat === "svg" ? "white" : "black"
                                }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: rmNotionOverlay.rmnSendFormat = "svg" }
                            }
                        }

                        // Whether the file renders on the Notion page or sits
                        // there as a download row.
                        Row {
                            spacing: 0
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 150; height: 64
                                color: rmNotionOverlay.rmnAttachAs === "embed" ? "black" : "white"
                                border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                                    text: "Embed"
                                    font.pixelSize: 26
                                    color: rmNotionOverlay.rmnAttachAs === "embed" ? "white" : "black"
                                }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: rmNotionOverlay.rmnAttachAs = "embed" }
                            }
                            Rectangle {
                                width: 150; height: 64
                                color: rmNotionOverlay.rmnAttachAs === "file" ? "black" : "white"
                                border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                                Text {
                                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                                    text: "File"
                                    font.pixelSize: 26
                                    color: rmNotionOverlay.rmnAttachAs === "file" ? "white" : "black"
                                }
                                MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: rmNotionOverlay.rmnAttachAs = "file" }
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    Rectangle {
                        width: 260; height: 64
                        border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                        TextInput {
                            id: rmnPageRange
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            anchors.margins: 14
                            font.pixelSize: 26
                            clip: true
                        }
                        Text {
                            anchors.fill: rmnPageRange
                            text: "Pages (e.g. 1-3)"
                            font.pixelSize: 24
                            color: "#999999"
                            visible: rmnPageRange.text === "" && !rmnPageRange.activeFocus
                        }
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: 180; height: 72
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.rightMargin: 32
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                    color: rmNotionOverlay.rmnSelectedTarget ? "black" : "#dddddd"
                    Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Send"; font.pixelSize: 30; color: "white" }
                    MouseArea {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        enabled: !!rmNotionOverlay.rmnSelectedTarget
                        onClicked: {
                            rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode = "sending"
                            rmNotionOverlay.rmnDefer("send")
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            Column {
                visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "sending"
                         || rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "done"
                         || rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "error"
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                spacing: 24
                width: 700

                Text {
                    width: parent.width
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                    font.pixelSize: 32
                    text: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "sending"
                          ? "Sending " + rmNotionOverlay.rmnDocName + "..."
                          : rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "done" ? "Sent to Notion"
                          : "Something went wrong"
                }
                Text {
                    visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "error"
                    width: parent.width
                    wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                    font.pixelSize: 26
                    color: "#444444"
                    text: rmNotionOverlay.rmnErrorText
                }
                Row {
                    anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                    spacing: 20
                    visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode !== "sending"

                    Rectangle {
                        visible: rmNotionOverlay.rmnMode === "error"
                        width: 200; height: 72
                        border.color: "black"; border.width: 2
                        Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Try again"; font.pixelSize: 28 }
                        MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: rmNotionOverlay.rmnDefer("refresh") }
                    }
                    Rectangle {
                        width: 200; height: 72
                        color: "black"
                        Text { anchors.centerIn: parent; text: "Close"; font.pixelSize: 28; color: "white" }
                        MouseArea { anchors.fill: parent; onClicked: rmNotionOverlay.rmnDismiss() }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
END SLOT

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Anchors for reMarkable OS 3.27.x (Paper Pure hashtab).
; Entry point: the share menu in the notebook toolbar — the foldout with
; "Present with Screen Share" / "Send by email" / "Convert and share".
; Send to Notion lands right after "Send by email".
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

; The toolbar carries the signal so the share row can reach the document
; view the same way the stock rows do (root.toolbar.<signal>()).
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            signal sendToNotionSelected
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; shareMenuContent is the ColumnLayout that holds the share buttons; the
; wildcard ?# finds it recursively. The row fires the toolbar signal by
; piggybacking on the sibling Send-by-email button's own toolbar reference
; (that button already uses root.toolbar internally), so no fragile toolbar
; The share buttons live in a ColumnLayout assigned to the ToolbarTool's
; foldoutContent property (objectName "shareMenuContent", no id). Reach it
; via root's children, then insert after Send-by-email. root.toolbar is in
; scope here (the sibling buttons use it), so the row fires the signal
; directly.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/ShareMenu.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#root > ColumnLayout
        LOCATE AFTER SendByEmailButton
        INSERT {
                Item {
                    id: rmNotionShareRow
                    Layout.fillWidth: true
                    // Lines up with the stock rows either side of it: a
                    // FoldoutItem is 112 tall and starts its content 32 in,
                    // with a little padding of its own inside that.
                    implicitHeight: 112

                    Rectangle {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        color: rmnRowTap.pressed ? "#e6e6e6" : "transparent"
                    }
                    // Notion's N mark, drawn from plain Rectangles: an
                    // outlined page with the two stems and the diagonal.
                    // Nothing to ship as an asset, and no dependency on the
                    // SVG image plugin or QtQuick.Shapes being available.
                    Item {
                        id: rmNotionMark
                        width: 40
                        height: 40
                        anchors.left: parent.left
                        anchors.leftMargin: 35
                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter

                        Rectangle {
                            anchors.fill: parent
                            color: "white"
                            border.color: "black"
                            border.width: 2
                            radius: 4
                        }
                        // Left stem, full height of the glyph.
                        Rectangle {
                            x: 10; y: 9
                            width: 5; height: 22
                            color: "black"
                        }
                        // Right stem, lighter than the left one as in the mark.
                        Rectangle {
                            x: 26; y: 9
                            width: 4; height: 22
                            color: "black"
                        }
                        // Diagonal from the top of the left stem to the foot
                        // of the right one: a vertical bar tilted to match
                        // atan(16/22) ≈ 36 degrees, anticlockwise so it
                        // leans the way the letter's stroke does.
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 5
                            height: 29
                            x: 20 - width / 2
                            y: 20 - height / 2
                            color: "black"
                            rotation: -36
                        }
                    }
                    Text {
                        anchors.left: rmNotionMark.right
                        anchors.leftMargin: 20
                        anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                        text: "Send to Notion"
                        font.pixelSize: 28
                    }
                    MouseArea {
                        id: rmnRowTap
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        onClicked: {
                            console.warn("[rmn] row tapped; toolbar=" + root.toolbar);
                            root.toolbar.sendToNotionSelected();
                            console.warn("[rmn] signal emitted");
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT SLOT rmNotionOverlay
        INSERT {
            function rmNotionOpenOverlay() {
                console.warn("[rmn] rmNotionOpenOverlay; overlay=" + rmNotionOverlay);
                var name = "Notebook";
                try {
                    var entry = Library.entryForId(document.id);
                    if (entry && entry.visibleName) name = entry.visibleName;
                } catch (e) {}
                rmNotionOverlay.rmnOpen(document.id, name, "");
            }
        }

        TRAVERSE Item#_uiContainer > Toolbar
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                onSendToNotionSelected: {
                    console.warn("[rmn] handler reached on Toolbar");
                    root.rmNotionOpenOverlay();
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
